The proponent's pages carry a confidentiality footer although the regulator serves the report publicly; no report page, table, photograph or prose is reproduced.
metadata.literal_pointer: PDF page 1 cover letter dated 27.05.2026 submitting the current status of construction work; PDF page 11 (printed 7) item 12 Status of construction; PDF page 13 (printed 9) PRESENT STATUS table, Building 1 and Building 2 rows.
metadata.visual_review_method: Complete Poppler-rendered pages reviewed; extracted layout text used as a cross-check. Site photographs on page 14 were viewed only to confirm the page's role and are not selected as imagery evidence.
metadata.independent_recapture: Root recapture on 2026-09-25 returned byte-identical content to the research lane's earlier same-day capture (same SHA-256 and length).
metadata.date_semantics: May 27 is the date of the signed cover letter that submits the current status of construction work. The table therefore describes status as of that letter, not the nominal October-March reporting period: the same report records actual commencement on 30.04.2026 and April 2026 spending. PARIVESH records the upload on 2026-05-30, which is when the statement became public. Neither date is an inspection day, and September retrieval does not refresh the observation.
metadata.authority_basis: Statutory six-monthly compliance report submitted by the proponent to the MoEFCC Integrated Regional Office, copied to MPCB, CPCB and the state environment department, and published on the national PARIVESH portal. The selected statement is the proponent's own report of physical work on the named EC project.
metadata.physical_status_scope: Broad under_construction for the EC project: excavation in progress on Building 1 and started on Building 2; Buildings 3-6 and ancillary structures not yet started. No finer stage, completion percentage, building count in service, capacity, energization or operation is inferred.
metadata.predecessor_contrast: The previous report, uploaded 2025-12-01, carries the remark that no construction work had started at the site; that report is not selected.
metadata.pdf_metadata_note: The PDF document-information title names an unrelated residential project, evidently a consultant template. The body, cover letter, proposal number and project name all identify this data-centre EC; the metadata title is not used as identity evidence.
metadata.successor_review: The research lane and root review searched Amazon's own India pages, the PARIVESH proposal and compliance listings, and dated regional reporting through August 20. No completion, opening, withdrawal, cancellation or legally effective stop order was found. A captured August 19 local report describes residents asking a state minister to relocate the centre, which it still calls under construction; that is opposition context, not a successor. Amazon India's June 29 facts page still calls the Thane centre upcoming. This is not an exhaustive permit, court or inspection audit.
